items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Joe Sherman wanted to put me in a concert opposite Vladimir Horowitz. And so I outsold Horowitz.

ctx.x: When did Joe Sherman come into your life. Was he your first manager?
No, he was not a manager. But he wanted to put me in a concert opposite Vladimir Horowitz. And so I outsold Horowitz.
